item.title: eWiz 0.18.8
item.description:
⌘Q no longer quits eWiz by accident

Clicking the panel or one of eWiz's windows makes eWiz the active app, so a ⌘Q meant for the app you were just using quit eWiz instead. It disappeared from the menu bar without a word, and hotkeys, automations and keep-awake stopped until you opened it again. ⌘Q now does nothing in eWiz; the power button in the panel is how you quit.
